title: NOHA Master's Programme
about: Erasmus Mundus joint master's programme in international humanitarian action run by the NOHA university network for the 2027-2029 cohort. Erasmus Mundus scholarship applications are accepted between 1 October and 15 December 2026; ordinary and self-funded applicants have later deadlines in 2027.
requirements: Degree studies completed by the 15 December 2026 application deadline (scholarship applicants)
card_alt: Card for the NOHA Master's Programme from the NOHA Network on Humanitarian Action, a multi-country programme with no single location, deadline 15 Dec 2026. The photo is a generic city skyline over a river at sunset, not a programme location.
